# Majordomus reel

> The Majordomus reel: every cut in the formats it is rendered in, its chapters and the Majordomus use cases each chapter shows, derived from the renders and the release, in this language. Paths are relative to the site's root. The pages, sitemap.xml and llms.txt are projections of this object.

Majordomus 1.1.0 (https://github.com/korczis/prismatic-majordomus/releases/tag/v1.1.0): 61 standard rules, 44 of 44 blocking rules with a validator, 169 decisions.

Machine-readable: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/data/reel.json

## Languages

- English: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/ (for language models https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/llms.txt, as data https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/data/reel.json)
- Čeština: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/cs/ (for language models https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/cs/llms.txt, as data https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/cs/data/reel.json)

## Cuts

- [The film](https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/): Every chapter of Majordomus, end to end. 10 min; rendered for phone; tablet plays phone and desktop plays phone
- [The short](https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/short/): The whole argument, for a feed. 3 min; rendered for phone; tablet plays phone and desktop plays phone
- [Getting started and adoption](https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/story-adoption/): Bringing Majordomus into a repository, new or old, without losing what people already wrote. 36 s; rendered for phone and desktop; tablet plays desktop
- [Sessions and handover](https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/story-continuity/): Stopping and resuming work across sessions and workers from durable state, never a transcript. 2 min; rendered for phone and desktop; tablet plays desktop
- [Parallel workers](https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/story-workers/): Several agents or people on one repository: claimed scopes, overlap, and who touched what. 2 min; rendered for phone and desktop; tablet plays desktop
- [Policy and enforcement](https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/story-policy/): Declaring rules, proving they are wired, and reproducing a finding. 71 s; rendered for phone; tablet plays phone and desktop plays phone
- [Completion and quality gates](https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/story-completion/): Deciding whether work is finished, with a contract every line of which passes or fails. 80 s; rendered for phone; tablet plays phone and desktop plays phone
- [Drift and reconciliation](https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/story-drift/): Detecting that policy, projections, state and git disagree, and putting them back in step. 61 s; rendered for phone; tablet plays phone and desktop plays phone
- [Repository knowledge](https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/story-knowledge/): What the repository declares about itself: sources, nodes, edges, the plan, and searching them. 2 min; rendered for phone; tablet plays phone and desktop plays phone
- [Serving the layer to AI clients](https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/story-mcp/): One shared server per repository, every client a peer, the same layer over MCP, HTTP and the command line. 81 s; rendered for phone; tablet plays phone and desktop plays phone
- [Extension](https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/story-extension/): Adding a kind, a rule, a command or a use case as data, with the checks that follow from it. 40 s; rendered for phone; tablet plays phone and desktop plays phone

## Use cases, by category

### Getting started and adoption

Story: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/story-adoption/

- [Adopt a repository that already has its own rules](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/adopt-an-existing-repository/), seen at 2:06: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=126
- [Install the tool in one command, on a machine with no toolchain](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/install-the-tool-in-one-command/), seen at 2:06: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=126
- [Check the version before trusting a diagnosis](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/know-which-tool-is-running/)
- [Move a repository from the pre-.ai layout to the layer](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/migrate-from-the-old-layout/)
- [Use the tool as your own in a shared repository, and propose it to the team when it has made its case](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/use-the-tool-as-your-own-in-a-shared-repository/), seen at 9:32: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=572

### Sessions and handover

Story: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/story-continuity/

- [Keep the prompts that started the work, below the model rather than around it](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/capture-the-prompts-that-started-the-work/)
- [Hand work over with a question still open, and keep it blocking](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/carry-a-blocker-across-a-handover/), seen at 8:51: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=531
- [Checkpoint long work so a stop costs minutes, not the day](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/checkpoint-long-work/), seen at 8:51: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=531
- [Hand unfinished work to the next session](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/hand-work-between-sessions/), seen at 2:47: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=167
- [Record a decision so the next worker can find it](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/keep-decisions-out-of-the-transcript/), seen at 8:59: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=539
- [Have the session opened and closed without anybody remembering to](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/let-the-provider-draw-the-episode-boundary/)
- [Record what one worker did in one sitting](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/open-and-close-a-session/), seen at 9:17: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=557
- [Read only the context that fits the budget, and know what was dropped](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/read-only-the-context-that-fits/), seen at 2:47: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=167
- [Close an episode whose client never came back](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/recover-an-episode-nobody-closed/), seen at 9:17: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=557
- [Start a session from a rendered framing, not a pasted transcript](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/resume-from-a-prompt-asset/)
- [Resume in the right worktree, never against somebody else’s task](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/resume-in-the-right-worktree/), seen at 6:46: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=406

- [Run several workers in one repository without them colliding](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/run-several-workers-at-once/), seen at 5:46: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=346
- [Work on a branch in the one worktree it belongs to](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/work-on-a-branch-in-its-canonical-worktree/), seen at 6:46: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=406

### Policy and enforcement

Story: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/story-policy/

- [Gate CI on the tool itself, with an exit code that is a contract](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/gate-ci-on-the-tool-itself/), seen at 1:02: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=62
- [Divide a working tree into commits, and hold every message to a policy](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/plan-a-commit-and-judge-its-message/)
- [Prove a rule is actually enforced, not merely written down](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/prove-a-rule-is-enforced/), seen at 0:45: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=45
- [See which rules apply here and what enforces them](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/read-the-rules-the-tool-applies/), seen at 0:45: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=45
- [Trust the policy and the profiles only after they are validated](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/trust-the-policy-before-reading-it/), seen at 1:02: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=62

- [Catch an agent that says it is done when it is not](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/catch-an-agent-that-says-it-is-done/), seen at 0:00: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=0

- [Know whether the work in this checkout is finished](https://majordomus.dev/use-cases/know-whether-this-work-is-finished/), seen at 0:24: https://korczis.github.io/majordomus-reel/?t=24
